title: Fig Makes a Gift for Nell
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar sitting on a green leaf, thinking, with a small empty spot beside him ready for a gift.
Fig the caterpillar crawling slowly along a garden path dotted with small puddles, looking for things.
Fig the caterpillar next to a small, smooth white stone beside a puddle on the path.
Fig the caterpillar beside a single bright yellow flower petal lying on the path.
Fig the caterpillar next to a thin, curly brown twig on the garden path.
Fig the caterpillar arranging a white stone, a yellow petal and a curly twig in a tidy row on a leaf.
Fig the caterpillar wrapping a thin blade of green grass around a small bundle of objects.
Fig the caterpillar carrying a small bundled gift towards Nell the bee.
Nell the bee looking closely at a small bundled gift, grinning with delight.
Nell the bee and Fig the caterpillar sitting together on a leaf with a small gift between them.
